North Dakota has three mapped data center facilities, and the data records zero megawatts of total capacity for them, which means the power picture here is either undisclosed or not yet captured.

The three facilities are Applied Digital in Harwood, Dakota Carrier Network in Cass County, and Atlas Powr Williston Datacenter in Williams County, operated by Atlas Power Holdings (ND) LLC. They are spread across the state, from the Fargo metro area in the east to the Williston Basin in the west. Only one facility carries an operator name in the data, and none carry a capacity figure.

Because total megawatts read as zero, this page cannot support any claim about North Dakota's contribution to AI compute or grid load. What the data does establish is that organized data center development is present in the state across at least two geographically distinct regions. Whether that development is at a scale relevant to AI training or inference workloads is not answerable from what is recorded here.
